name: Coarse Weightstone
label: Quest
description: Coarse Weightstone: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It takes a lot of work to be the strongest woman alive! My weight set is getting too light and if I'm too stay fit then I'll need more weights!
Do you think you could bring me some weight stones? If you do, then I'll give you a Darkmoon Faire ticket.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great! These will work great! They're not too heavy, but not too light either. They're perfect for building muscle mass!
Thanks much, friend. Here's your Darkmoon Faire ticket!
